- “Goal for this session: replace the hand-rolled retry loop in ledgerly/sync/client.py with tenacity.”
- “separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'avatar-cdn-batched-migration' in between your other work. Goal: Copy local avatar files to the production CDN and update user avatar URLs in verified database batches. Run these steps in order, one at a time:”
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”
- “Treat any field ending in _secret, _token, or _fingerprint as restricted and copy only through ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context.”

- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”
- “Increasing the Celery visibility_timeout to 6 hours was already tried for the duplicate job runs; it made stuck jobs invisible for hours. Ruled out, do not retry.”

- “Stop the tenacity refactor, we will revisit it next sprint. New priority: the nightly reconciliation job in ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py is double-counting refunds; fix that.”

## Current objective
Fix refund double-counting in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. Tenacity migration is superseded until next sprint; continue the avatar procedure interleaved, one step at a time.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Staging host: `db-stg-2.internal`; `db-stg-1.internal` and `config/staging.yaml` are superseded.
- Avatars: `/srv/app/avatars`; `s3://cdn-prod-user-avatars`; 18,432 files; manifest `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv`; archive `snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz`.
- `request_id`; `bind_request_id()` in `ledgerly/observability/context.py`; `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.
- SQLAlchemy `DeclarativeBase`, `session.get()`; `declarative_base()`, `Query.get()`, and `echo=True` are superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Six-hour Celery `visibility_timeout`.
- Raw PDF page-height arithmetic.
- Repeated invoice continuation-header reservation.
- Legacy SQLAlchemy APIs, direct session defaults, `echo=True`, and wildcard repository imports.
- Tenacity refactor is paused, not ruled out.

## Recent work
Logging and payment exception handling changes passed focused tests. Avatar migration steps 1–4 completed: connectivity/indexing, manifest generation, migration-run insert, and CDN upload. Scheduler DST bug was fixed and all scheduler tests passed; a midnight-transition regression test was added but not yet run. Full suite previously had one health-log expectation failure, then the focused health tests passed. The next avatar step must be completed individually before proceeding; the reconciliation refund fix remains the main goal.

## Current objective
Replace the hand-rolled retry loop in `ledgerly/sync/client.py` with `tenacity`. The avatar migration is a required interleaved procedure, not a replacement goal. SQLAlchemy modernization and PDF pagination work were side work.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Invoice `1048`: `items=86`, debug reported `pages=3`, `last_page_fill=0.97`.
- Added `_row_height(points: float) -> float`, returning `points / 72`.
- Current SQLAlchemy model base: `DeclarativeBase`; `declarative_base()` is superseded.
- Deprecated `Invoice.query.get(invoice_id)` superseded by `session.get(Invoice, invoice_id)`.
- SQLAlchemy engine option `echo=True` removed.
- Staging database host: `db-stg-1.internal`.
- Existing `expire_on_commit=True` was not yet changed.
- Avatar source `/srv/app/avatars`; bucket `cdn-prod-user-avatars`; manifest `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv`; archive `snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz`.
- Legacy session factories remain in `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, and `tests/conftest.py`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Raw PDF height arithmetic was replaced by `_row_height()` because it mishandled page-height budgets.
- Repeated continuation-header reservation caused the 86-item invoice to render as 3 pages; computing it once allows 2 pages.
- SQLAlchemy legacy `declarative_base()` and `Query.get()` were replaced due to SQLAlchemy 2.0 deprecations.
- Do not retain engine `echo=True`.

## Recent work
PDF pagination now passes `14 passed, 1 skipped`; billing passes `83 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed`; full baseline was `148 passed, 2 skipped`. Invoice repository tests report `19 passed` without `LegacyAPIWarning`. Next, visually compare the three generated PDFs, then resume the main retry-loop migration and run each avatar step separately in the specified order.
